cases.subject: PostgreSQL SSL certificate verify failed after renewal
cases.description: Our PostgreSQL connector stopped syncing when the database certificate was renewed. The intermediate certificate chain is expired.

cases.subject: JSON API request gets 415 unsupported media type
cases.description: The JSON payload is valid but Content-Type is text/plain instead of application/json.

cases.subject: VAT still charged for reverse-charge tax ID
cases.description: The EU business tax ID is validated but the invoice still includes VAT.

cases.subject: Webhook HMAC fails after JSON is parsed
cases.description: Our middleware reserializes JSON before webhook signature verification, changing raw request whitespace.

cases.subject: CSV cell values become spreadsheet formulas
cases.description: Opening the CSV in a spreadsheet interprets exported text as formulas. Formula injection protection is required.

cases.subject: Scheduled report one hour late after daylight saving
cases.description: The schedule uses a fixed UTC offset and shifted by an hour after daylight saving time.

cases.subject: One pending authorization and one settled card charge
cases.description: The customer thinks they were charged twice, but the processor has only one settled subscription charge and a pending authorization.

cases.subject: Valid API key returns forbidden 403 for dataset read
cases.description: The key authenticates but is missing dataset:read scope for a restricted dataset.

cases.subject: Snowflake warehouse connection fails with unfamiliar error
cases.description: The new Snowflake warehouse integration fails during connection setup. No diagnostic code or comparable supported integration is available.

cases.subject: Cafeteria lunch menu
cases.description: Please add vegetarian meals to the office cafeteria menu.

cases.subject: Heatmap clipping after latest browser update
cases.description: The heatmap axis labels are clipped on the new browser release and the investigation is ongoing.

cases.subject: Something is not working
cases.description: It failed again but no feature, error, or steps are available.

cases.subject: Old MFA backup codes stopped working
cases.description: We regenerated authenticator recovery codes and tried to use an unused code from the old set. Authentication rejects it.

cases.subject: SCIM group membership lost after employee email rename
cases.description: Provisioning matched the renamed employee by email instead of immutable external ID. The team group access is missing.

cases.subject: S3 export AccessDenied despite bucket permission
cases.description: The export worker can write to the bucket but the KMS encryption key policy denies access.

cases.subject: BigQuery connector unknown column after field renamed
cases.description: The source column was renamed and the connector schema mapping still uses the old name.

cases.subject: Password reset email absent even in spam
cases.description: The recipient is on the mail provider suppression list after a hard bounce. No password reset email arrives.

cases.subject: Safari iframe dashboard keeps looping to login
cases.description: The embedded dashboard cannot retain a session because third-party cookies are blocked by Safari.

cases.subject: Queued report export ran after permission revoked
cases.description: The worker used old submission-time permissions even though dataset access was revoked before processing.

cases.subject: Accented CSV names garbled when opened in Excel
cases.description: The UTF-8 export displays incorrect characters in an older Excel encoding configuration.

cases.subject: Webhook delivery timestamps rejected outside replay window
cases.description: The receiver clock is several minutes behind and signature verification rejects valid webhook timestamps.

cases.subject: API cursor pages repeat records during concurrent inserts
cases.description: The sort key is unstable and new records appear while the client paginates through the dataset.

cases.subject: Pending card hold versus settled payment
cases.description: There is only one settled charge, but the statement also shows a pending authorization that has not settled.

cases.subject: Kafka consumer rebalance loses committed offsets
cases.description: An unfamiliar Kafka consumer group loses offsets during a rebalance. This product does not have any Kafka support precedents.

cases.subject: Laptop battery swollen

cases.subject: Help please

cases.description: A possible SQL query access boundary incident is still being investigated with no approved reusable security resolution.

cases.description: The new heatmap clipping problem is open and no root cause or reviewed fix is available.
